verdict.rationale: Secret-scanning products can plausibly offer platform API tokens with scopes, and gitleaks.io describes team-wide and on-demand scanning, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a local CLI, a pre-commit hook, and a GitHub Action that consumes a GitHub-issued token. There is no evidence that Gitleaks issues scoped or least-privilege credentials of its own, and probes found no API surface.
